note: Status becomes FROZEN via tools/freeze_policy.py which requires every null field to be filled from baseline-vs-oracle measurements (P1) and writes acceptance_policy.frozen.json + SHA256. Unset tolerances block promotion. Never loosen after a failure.

identities.target_dispatch: gfx1201, bits==3, codebook==mul1 (cb 2), fp16 in/out, M==1
identities.gpu: AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT (gfx1201, wave32, 32 CU)

scope_gates.eligible_predicate: arch==gfx1201 AND bits==3 AND codebook==mul1 AND dtype==fp16 AND size_m==1 AND size_k%128==0 AND size_n%128==0 AND suh+A_had+svh present
scope_gates.fallback_contract: unsupported calls must decline without modifying outputs and run the pinned-fork fp16 path unchanged
scope_gates.int8_arithmetic_not_bitwise: the int8 activation path is a separate numerical change with its own budget; it is never claimed bitwise-equivalent to fp16

exactness.rule: bit-exact equality against reference/exl3_oracle.py and, for regression parity, against the pinned fork's ext.reconstruct / ext.decode

float_gates_same_arithmetic.comment: P3 candidate (same arithmetic as baseline) vs FP32 oracle. Metrics are scale-aware (normalizing by output RMS) because output magnitude varies ~100x across shapes. Bounds below are analytic/accumulation-order ceilings from fp16-boundary staging + fp32 accumulation; the measured baseline deviations (null now) set the actual gate = max(analytic, 4x measured_baseline_worst).
float_gates_same_arithmetic.abs_rel_definition: |diff| <= 4e-3 * RMS(ref) + 2e-3 * |ref| per element; abs_rel_bound_ratio is max |diff| / bound, must be <= 1.0
float_gates_same_arithmetic.final_gate_rule: gate(metric) = max(analytic_bound(metric), 4 * measured_baseline(metric)) computed at freeze; recorded in the frozen file

float_gates_int8_plain.comment: P4 plain int8 mode: activation quantization is an intended numerical change. Budget frozen before optimization; upstream reports ~0.9% output RMS deviation; CPU oracle measures ~0.55% on random fixtures. Budget set from baseline-vs-oracle on REAL tensors before any candidate runs.

float_gates_int8_residual.comment: P4 residual mode (~15-16 bit effective activation precision). CPU oracle measures ~0.03% NRMS on random fixtures.

model_level_gates.comment: Frozen before any candidate evaluation. Teacher-forced logits on identical histories are the gate; greedy text equality is diagnostic only.

teacher_forced.prompts: fixtures/prompts_calibration.jsonl (calibration) and fixtures/prompts_holdout.jsonl (final holdout, never used for tuning)
teacher_forced.metric: logit max-abs-diff and KL vs pinned-baseline teacher-forced logits

generation_stability.rule: greedy decode on holdout prompts must stay coherent; token equality is diagnostic, not the gate

performance_gates.comment: Frozen at P2 per IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md. Paired trials: 10 decision pairs + 5 reserved confirmation pairs for the selected winner only.
performance_gates.order: alternate baseline/candidate ordering across pairs after warmup
reporting_rules: weighted layer time using actual dispatch frequencies; never an unweighted average of per-shape speedups as a tokens/s claim
kernel speedup and model speedup reported separately
unprofiled performance measured; traces collected in separate runs
invalidation_rules: a trial is invalid only for a predeclared environmental condition: competing GPU process visible in rocm-smi, GPU edge temp > 90C, thermal throttle flag, or clock override detected
invalid samples are retained with reasons, never discarded

memory_fit_budget_derivation: 15 GiB cap on 16.3 GiB RX 9070 XT, reserving at least 1.3 GiB desktop headroom; validate baseline fit and actual available VRAM at P0 before freeze

int_accumulation.rule: prove int32 accumulation cannot overflow for supported K_in
int_accumulation.bound: per dp4a term |i| <= 127 and byte_sum <= 1020 -> |term| <= 129540; K_in=17408 with per-slice partials <= 512 rows*16 terms per accumulator -> worst partial < 2^31 / 16; full-sum recombination in float32

budgets.stall_rule: six consecutive correct candidates without material gain ends that hypothesis family
stop_conditions: kernel reaches >= 90% of the measured sustainable streaming roofline (bench_layer efficiency) -- stop GEMV micro-tuning and move up to fusion
another component dominates end-to-end decode time
three substantial optimization attempts each yield < 1% improvement
further complexity carries unacceptable correctness/maintenance cost
budgets.fault_rule: GPU fault / reset / device loss / repeated hang stops GPU execution immediately; preserve logs; require healthy-device preflight before resuming; never reset GPU, kill unrelated processes, change clocks or drivers
